description: §55.1 (D-FORM-6) — the passing side of predicate-applicability. `<age min(18)>: number` (number predicate on a number cell) and `<label length(>=2)>: string` (length on a string cell) are both correctly-typed applications → NO E-TYPE-031. Guards against a false type-mismatch fire on valid predicate/cell pairings.
rationale: §55.1 predicate-applicability: `min` applies to `number` cells and `length` applies to `string`-or-`array` cells. With explicit annotations pinning the types, both applications are well-typed and must compile clean. The applicability check only fires on a CONFIDENT mismatch, never on a correct pairing. S478 (boot-false-positives): both cells are now written (`@label` by a `bind:value`, `@age` by `older()`). As first written nothing wrote them, so their §66 twin is LOCKED (§66.21 row 1, S449 dialect ruling 2: locked "only when the cell is never written") — and validators on a value nothing can change are E-VALIDATOR-DEAD (§55.5.2: "Validators on a value are dead … only when nothing can ever change the value"), an error unrelated to applicability. The pairings under test are unchanged.
